## Operator decision: CLOSE as OBE / intended-behavior

Reviewed with the orchestrator operator (2026-08-28). Confirming the escalation's recommended option (a): close as largely overtaken-by-events.

Rationale (see prior RCA comment for full evidence):
- 2 of 3 proposed actuators already ship (tool_calls_limit; tool-free finalizer).
- The runaway loop is already bounded into re-runnable recovery by the served-streak backstop (a0fc8d43, landed 11 days before this ticket) + the 2dcb misclassification fix.
- The sole residual (passive nudge -> hard ModelRetry steer) reverses cited design f6fc (byte-stable nudge for prompt caching), has cross-gate blast radius (shared agent_call seam for all four LLM reviewers), and risks re-introducing the 3211 false-positive-abort class.
- No cited authoritative source requires the hard steer; the correctness harms are already mitigated.

No caused_by attribution (not a defect). Closing --class=duplicate: the actionable correctness content is subsumed by landed work (2dcb + a0fc8d43/3211). If the hard steer is still wanted later, re-scope as a task/story through plan-review so the prompt-cache-stability tradeoff is a deliberate human decision.
